_README: This file is the ONLY place a measured/calibrated end-effector-to-camera
transform should live. Anything not listed here falls back to the NOMINAL
values derived from giava.urdf / the MuJoCo model in camera_mount.py,
which have never been validated against the physical rig.
Nothing is filled in yet: GIAVA contains no hand-eye calibration.
Add an entry under 'cameras' keyed by the camera name used in
low_scene, oak_left, oak_right), following the schema below. Then
will report it as CALIBRATED instead of nominal.

_SCHEMA.rigid_to: URDF link the camera is bolted to, e.g. 'left_gripper_base'. For a static room camera use 'base' (the world frame) and give T_world_camera.
_SCHEMA.matrix_4x4_row_major: T_<rigid_to>_<camera>, row-major 4x4. Maps points from the CAMERA optical frame into the <rigid_to> frame; equivalently it IS the camera's pose expressed in <rigid_to>. Metres.
_SCHEMA.provenance: 'calibrated' for a real measurement. Free text describing the method is encouraged, e.g. 'calibrated:charuco_handeye_2026-08-20'.
_SCHEMA.validated: true only once the number has been checked against a physical measurement.
_SCHEMA.optical_frame_convention: Must be OpenCV: +x image-right, +y image-down, +z along the viewing axis. Convert before writing if your tool uses another.
_SCHEMA.rms_error: optional, the residual the calibration reported
_SCHEMA.n_samples: optional, how many robot poses / board views went in
_SCHEMA.note: optional free text: date, operator, board used, anything a future reader needs

_EXAMPLE_DO_NOT_USE.note: Identity placeholder showing the shape only. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader.
